title: Very low activity baseline (1.8k steps/day) — start where the user is

expectations.assert: sedentary baseline far below health-benefit region; largest relative benefit lies in early increments

initial target = baseline + small labeled increment (magnitude blocked on EVR-007); explicitly NOT 10,000 and NOT a +40% jump — the brief's 3,200→4,500 example is removed as policy ([CTO-QAE-001] §14)
minimumExposureDays set before any increase is considered
increases only after target consistently met over exposure period ∧ recovery stable ∧ budget/cooldown clear
honest 'approximate/starting-point' framing codes for the derived target
